nodeGroups.name: Establish login session
nodeGroups.description: Signs in as your account so the task API returns your own pending submissions

nodeGroups.name: Queue pending tasks
nodeGroups.description: Fetches every task still awaiting a submission and queues one row per task for later processing

nodeGroups.name: Restore platform session
nodeGroups.description: Loads the platform cookies you pasted and attaches the matching account session to each queued task

nodeGroups.name: Complete queued tasks
nodeGroups.description: Opens each queued link in the saved session, does the like/follow/watch, submits the task with the screenshot, then records the outcome
